scope: Christ the Redeemer, Rio de Janeiro
title: Christ the Redeemer
blurb: The 30 m Art Deco statue of Christ on Corcovado mountain, arms spanning 28 m, on an 8 m pedestal. Designed by Paul Landowski and built 1922 to 1931 from reinforced concrete faced with soapstone.

systems.name: Pedestal
systems.description: The 8 m octagonal stone pedestal carrying the statue, with the chapel door.

systems.name: Viewing platform
systems.description: The viewing deck and railings around the pedestal base.

systems.name: Legs and feet
systems.description: The robed legs, feet and toes of the figure.

systems.name: Robe
systems.description: The Art Deco drapery: torso, waist sash, skirt and sixteen sculpted folds.

systems.name: Outstretched arms
systems.description: The 28 m span of open arms: upper arms, forearms, sleeves, hands, fingers and thumbs.

systems.name: Head
systems.description: The head fashioned by Gheorghe Leonida: face, hair, beard and features.

systems.name: Chapel
systems.description: The Chapel of Nossa Senhora Aparecida inside the pedestal, consecrated 2006.

systems.name: Corcovado peak
systems.description: The summit platform and rock of Corcovado mountain, 700 m above Rio.
